answer.summary: Two deterministic failures tied to this change. TenantBackgroundTransactionArchTest flags FindingService.generateFindings calling its own @Transactional recordFindingsByInject (intra-class call bypasses the Spring proxy), and FindingService/FindingRecordingService are in the touched files. PinnedActiveTablesArchTest fails on baseline line counts (94 vs 95, 95 vs 96) after classes were changed; it has persisted 3 times before. Re-running will likely fail the same way.

evidence.quote: Architecture Violation [Priority: MEDIUM] - Rule 'classes should not call a @Transactional method of the same class
The probe and control lines number 94, not DELIBERATE_SIZE 95. Removed one? Lower the constant.
The drifts lines number 95, not DEBT_SIZE 96. Converted a class? Lower the constant. A new class follows the production list instead.
